test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "must."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence is discussing the necessity for drivers to learn to be patient instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control.
 
• **"Must"** emphasizes the obligation or necessity of the action, making it the most appropriate option in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

Correct paragraph:

All drivers are affected by road rage, whether they are directly or indirectly involved__ Individual coping qualities __influence__ the behaviour of stressful drivers. Instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control, drivers __**must**__ learn to be patient. On the road, we must be ______ (4) ______ to control our own emotions. Road raged drivers are also more likely to ______ (5) _______ more traffic offences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Ought:** to express moral obligation, duty, or advisability. It is often used to indicate what is considered the right or proper thing to do. 
 
• **Can: **indicates ability or capability rather than obligation or necessity.
 
• **To: **a preposition or part of an infinitive verb form, but it doesn't convey the sense of obligation or necessity by itself.
